title: Atomic Consistency Preference Optimization for Long-Form Question Answering
authors_zh: Jingfeng Chen、Raghuveer Thirukovalluru、Junlin Wang、Kaiwei Luo、Bhuwan Dhingra（杜克大学昆山大学、杜克大学、TeleAI）
paper_type_zh: 自监督偏好数据构造与事实性对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究如何在不依赖外部评审器或知识库的条件下，把模型重复输出转化为偏好监督的读者。
one_line: ACPO turns agreement among sentence-level facts in sampled long-form answers into chosen-rejected pairs for factuality-oriented DPO.
ACPO 将长回答中句子级事实在多次采样中的一致程度转化为优选—劣选回答对，并用它进行面向事实性的直接偏好优化。
why: It makes atomic agreement, cluster frequency, and response ranking explicit data-construction decisions rather than relying on a stronger factuality judge.
inclusion_reason: It transforms multiple generated answers into scored preference records and optimizes a DPO consumer with that self-supervised signal.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-form answers can contain many plausible details, so a model may sound knowledgeable while quietly inserting unsupported facts. Existing factuality alignment commonly asks a stronger model or an external knowledge base to judge generated claims, but those resources can be costly, unavailable, or themselves unsuitable for scalable training.

ACPO asks whether a model can construct factuality preference pairs from its own answers. It treats agreement among independently sampled sentence-level facts as a training signal, then uses the resulting comparison between a high-consistency and a low-consistency answer to make long-form question answering more reliable.

长篇回答可以包含大量看似合理的细节，因此模型即使悄悄插入没有依据的事实，也仍会显得很有知识。现有的事实性对齐通常请更强的模型或外部知识库判断生成的断言，但这些资源可能昂贵、不可获得，或本身不适合大规模训练。

ACPO 询问，模型能否从自己的回答中构造事实性偏好对。它把独立采样的句子级事实之间的一致程度视为训练信号，再利用高一致回答与低一致回答之间形成的比较，提高长篇问答的可靠性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central assumption is not that every repeated statement is true. Instead, ACPO uses repeated agreement as a relative preference signal: within responses to the same question, a fact that recurs in several independently generated answers is treated as more trustworthy than a fact that appears only once.

This changes factuality alignment from claim verification into record construction. Each question produces a small population of answers, their sentence facts are clustered by meaning, and the frequency pattern becomes a score that identifies which answer should be preferred during direct preference optimization.

核心假设并不是每个重复出现的陈述都是真的。相反，ACPO 将重复的一致性用作相对偏好信号：在同一问题的多个回答中，若一个事实在若干独立生成的回答里反复出现，它就被视为比只出现一次的事实更可信。

这把事实性对齐从断言核验改造成记录构造。每个问题产生一个小型回答群体，回答中的句子事实按语义聚类，频率模式随后变成一个分数，用于确定在直接偏好优化中应当偏向哪一个回答。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every LongFact training question, the base policy produces 30 responses. ACPO tokenizes each response into sentences, uses SimCSE sentence embeddings with agglomerative clustering to merge semantically similar statements, and labels a cluster consistent when it contains at least two statements. A response gains one point for each fact in a consistent cluster and loses one for each fact in a non-consistent cluster.

The pipeline sorts the 30 responses by this score and records the top response as chosen and the bottom response as rejected. Those pairs train Llama-3-8B-Instruct or Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct using DPO with beta 0.1. The reported implementation trains on 2,097 LongFact questions; the paper also studies length-balanced variants and applies the same atomic-consistency selector at inference as an ablation.

对于每个 LongFact 训练问题，基础策略生成 30 个回答。ACPO 将每个回答切分为句子，利用 SimCSE 句向量和凝聚聚类合并语义相近的陈述，并在一个簇至少包含两个陈述时将其标为一致簇。回答中每个落入一致簇的事实加一分，每个落入不一致簇的事实减一分。

该流程按分数排列 30 个回答，并把最高分回答记录为优选、最低分回答记录为劣选。随后这些回答对以 beta 为 0.1 的直接偏好优化训练 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 或 Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct。报告的实现使用 2,097 个 LongFact 问题训练；论文还研究了长度平衡变体，并把同一原子一致性选择器用于推理阶段的消融实验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On LongFact and BioGen, ACPO is compared with the unaligned model and FactAlign, a supervised factuality-alignment baseline. Across Llama-3 and Phi-3 in the four reported benchmark settings, the paper reports an average factual-precision gain of 1.95 points over FactAlign. On LongFact with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, the reported F1 is 83.84 for ACPO, compared with 80.32 for FactAlign and 75.88 for the raw model.

The paper also measures construction cost. Its embedding-and-clustering route takes 3.3 seconds per example, versus 922.1 seconds for sentence facts verified by GPT-4 and 1,376.0 seconds when GPT-4 both generates and verifies atomic facts. Removing the penalty for rare facts lowers BioGen factual precision from 51.8 to 46.9, supporting the claimed role of both positive and negative consistency signals.

在 LongFact 和 BioGen 上，ACPO 与未对齐模型以及有监督的事实性对齐基线 FactAlign 比较。论文在 Llama-3 与 Phi-3 的四个报告基准设置上，给出相对 FactAlign 平均提升 1.95 个点的事实精确率。在使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的 LongFact 上，ACPO 报告的 F1 为 83.84，而 FactAlign 为 80.32，原始模型为 75.88。

论文还测量了构造成本。它的嵌入与聚类路线每个样例需 3.3 秒，而用 GPT-4 核验句子事实需 922.1 秒，既由 GPT-4 生成又核验原子事实需 1,376.0 秒。去除对罕见事实的惩罚后，BioGen 的事实精确率从 51.8 降至 46.9，支持了正向与负向一致性信号都发挥作用的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier factuality pipelines often verify each claim against retrieved evidence or outsource quality judgment to a stronger language model. ACPO instead uses the distribution of the current model's own sampled statements, so its supervision source is internal agreement rather than a separately supplied factual label.

Its distinctive contribution is to make that agreement granular enough for long answers. The method does not vote over a whole response; it clusters sentence-level facts, turns cluster membership into a signed response score, and writes a standard chosen-rejected record that can be consumed by DPO. This preserves a simple optimizer while changing how its training comparisons are produced.

较早的事实性流程常把每项断言与检索到的证据核对，或把质量判断外包给更强的语言模型。ACPO 则使用当前模型自己采样陈述的分布，因此它的监督来源是内部一致，而不是另行提供的事实标签。

它的独特贡献在于把这种一致性细化到足以处理长回答的程度。该方法不对整个回答投票；它聚类句子级事实，将簇成员关系转化为带正负号的回答分数，并写出可由直接偏好优化消费的标准优选—劣选记录。这样它保留了简单的优化器，同时改变了训练比较的产生方式。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Consistency is only a proxy for truth: a model can repeat a shared misconception, and an infrequent but correct detail may be punished. Sentence boundaries are also a rough substitute for atomic facts, calibration differs by base model, and the paper's own second self-training iteration did not improve test results, suggesting overfitting risk. The study is limited to English LongFact and BioGen and does not provide a dedicated contamination analysis.
一致性只是真实性的代理：模型可能反复陈述同一个共同误解，而罕见但正确的细节也可能被惩罚。句子边界也是原子事实的粗略替代，不同基础模型的校准程度不同，且论文自身的第二轮自训练没有改善测试结果，这提示存在过拟合风险。该研究限于英文 LongFact 和 BioGen，且没有提供专门的数据污染分析。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful when a team needs factuality-oriented preference data but cannot afford claim-by-claim external verification. Its record design is concrete: retain sampled answers, sentence segments, semantic clusters, threshold, signed scores, and the selected pair so that the data-construction decision can be audited or replaced. It is especially relevant for long-form answers where a single final-answer vote cannot expose local factual disagreement.
当团队需要面向事实性的偏好数据、却无法负担逐项断言的外部核验时，这篇论文很有用。它的记录设计很具体：保留采样回答、句子片段、语义簇、阈值、带符号分数和选出的回答对，使数据构造决策能够被审计或替换。它尤其适合长篇回答，因为单一最终答案投票无法暴露局部事实分歧。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as a data-selection recipe rather than as a generic hallucination solution. The important experimental controls are the number of samples, sentence embedding and clustering threshold, consistency threshold, length effects, and whether a direct DPO model beats an inference-only selector. Before reuse, test whether cluster frequency correlates with correctness in the target domain and retain provenance for every generated response and selected pair.
应将这篇论文当作数据选择配方阅读，而不是泛泛的幻觉解决方案。重要的实验控制包括采样数量、句子嵌入与聚类阈值、一致性阈值、长度效应，以及直接偏好优化模型是否胜过只在推理时使用的选择器。复用前，应测试簇频率是否与目标领域中的正确性相关，并为每个生成回答和选出的回答对保留来源信息。
